Columns

Multi-column layout utilities for creating vertical column arrangements with responsive widths and nesting support.

Basic Columns

Create simple multi-column layouts using .zak-columns with .zak-column children. Columns automatically share equal width.

Column 1

Equal width

Column 2

Equal width

Column 3

Equal width

HTML
<div class="zak-columns">
  <div class="zak-column">Column 1</div>
  <div class="zak-column">Column 2</div>
  <div class="zak-column">Column 3</div>
</div>

Responsive Columns

Use breakpoint classes to change the number of columns at different screen sizes.

1
2
3
4
HTML
<div class="zak-columns zak-columns-1 zak-columns-sm-2 zak-columns-md-3 zak-columns-lg-4">
  <div class="zak-column">1</div>
  <div class="zak-column">2</div>
  <div class="zak-column">3</div>
  <div class="zak-column">4</div>
</div>

Column Widths

Assign explicit widths to individual columns using width utilities or fractional classes.

25%
50%
25%
1/3
2/3
HTML
<div class="zak-columns">
  <div class="zak-column" style="width: 25%">25%</div>
  <div class="zak-column" style="width: 50%">50%</div>
  <div class="zak-column" style="width: 25%">25%</div>
</div>

<div class="zak-columns">
  <div class="zak-column zak-col-1-3">1/3</div>
  <div class="zak-column zak-col-2-3">2/3</div>
</div>

Nested Columns

Columns can be nested inside other columns for complex layouts. The nested columns split the parent column's width equally.

Parent Column (50%)

Nested 1
Nested 2
Nested 3

Parent Column (50%)

No nesting here

HTML
<div class="zak-columns">
  <div class="zak-column">
    Parent Column
    <div class="zak-columns">
      <div class="zak-column">Nested 1</div>
      <div class="zak-column">Nested 2</div>
      <div class="zak-column">Nested 3</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="zak-column">
    Parent Column
  </div>
</div>

CSS Reference

HTML
.zak-columns {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.zak-column {
  flex: 1 1 0%;
  min-width: 0;
}

.zak-col-1-3 { flex: 0 0 33.333%; max-width: 33.333%; }
.zak-col-2-3 { flex: 0 0 66.667%; max-width: 66.667%; }
.zak-col-1-4 { flex: 0 0 25%; max-width: 25%; }
.zak-col-3-4 { flex: 0 0 75%; max-width: 75%; }

Accessibility

  • Columns maintain DOM order for screen readers regardless of visual layout
  • Avoid using columns for essential content — ensure content remains readable in a single column
  • Use semantic HTML elements within columns for better accessibility
